name: After Dark Audio Story Narration
description: Audio-first workflow focusing on paranormal account collection, script layout, and voice optimization.

steps.name: Account Collection
steps.description: Research the topic on the live web before writing anything: search from several angles (the legend or event, the real place/job/setting and how it works, the folklore entity and its regional rules, what has been told about it before), read the best pages, and deliver the cited dossier with story material (world, folklore, real details, story seeds, twists) for a Raat3Baje story episode.

steps.name: Script Writing
steps.description: Write the complete story episode from the research package: a layered, specific Indian horror story (surface events, a hidden history underneath, a truth at the end that re-reads the earlier scenes), with plants that pay off, incidents that escalate, named characters with a reason to stay, and real texture from the research. Pure story from the first word to the last; the greeting once, at the start; mark long pauses and cues where the format allows.

steps.name: Visual Plan
steps.description: Produce structured per-scene image/clip prompts (visual_plan.json) for BuzzEdit/ComfyUI.

steps.name: Sound Design Plan
steps.description: List sound effects and compile dark drone background tracks to blend under V.O.

steps.name: Narration Check
steps.description: Read draft out loud, adjust pacing pauses, check pronunciations, and optimize flow.

steps.name: SEO & Thumbnail
steps.description: Generate dark-themed titles, tags, and custom YouTube metadata packages.
